how: We read the website of every Philadelphia wedding videographer listed on Lazo (168 listings, 139 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a white-label editing back office for other videographers, a national chain's city page, DJ companies and photographers filed under video, and a corporate studio. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you record the vows and toasts: lapel mics and a DJ board feed, or just the camera? Historic Philadelphia churches and stone barns swallow sound.
What do I get and when: a highlight film, a full-length edit with chapters, raw footage? Ask for delivery dates in writing.
Is there an hourly cap, and what does it cost if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Philly Wedding Film
picks.blurb: Philly Wedding Film prints its base package on the site, with what it calls all the essentials to film the day, and makes a point of being totally upfront with pricing. The mission is a cinematic film you relive over and over, for couples marrying in Philadelphia and beyond.

picks.name: Martin's Accent Wedding Videos
picks.blurb: A full-time, family-owned business that has specialized in wedding videos for over 20 years. Martin's delivers a full-length edited and chaptered video along with a shareable highlight recap, shoots documentary-style, and covers Philadelphia, West Chester, Cherry Hill, Atlantic City and New Jersey; all packages cover the full ceremony and reception.

picks.name: Last Tango Films
picks.blurb: Last Tango Films in Pennsauken is a small team that says it knows weddings, not just cameras: they show up early, stay until the end, and stay on top of things in between, rather than leaving as the party gets going. Cinematic wedding films, based in New Jersey and available worldwide.

picks.name: New Pace Weddings
picks.blurb: New Pace Weddings is an Ardmore boutique studio where the videographer, photographer, editor and a wedding timeline coordinator work as one team. Timeless photo, video and content creation for the modern couple, since 2007.

picks.name: ALLIANCE VIDEO PRODUCTIONS LLC
picks.blurb: Alliance Video Productions was formed in 1994 and has filmed over 2,000 weddings with a team of videographers, cinematographers and editors. Every video is fully edited with fast online delivery included, and packages range through highlight reels and trailers for New Jersey, Philadelphia and Delaware.

picks.name: Nostalgia Ultra Weddings
picks.blurb: Malik Robinson, born and raised in Philadelphia with 15-plus years behind the lens, films weddings without staging moments or interrupting the flow. Nostalgia Ultra Weddings describes its films as unfiltered and honest, with packages that are customizable to the budget and add-ons like a web trailer.

picks.name: Valley Creek Productions
picks.blurb: Valley Creek Productions has been turning real moments into films since 2005, for couples as well as businesses across the greater Philadelphia region. Based in Coatesville and named for the Valley Creek waterway, with a focus on storytelling and a seamless client experience.

picks.name: Nightjar Pictures
picks.blurb: Brad and Jenna of Nightjar Pictures make handcrafted wedding films and photography out of Wilmington for Greater Philadelphia, New Jersey and Delaware. The package on the site spells it out: a 12 to 15 minute edited highlight film, eight hours of coverage, full-length ceremony and reception formalities, and $100 per extra hour per shooter.

picks.name: Elm AV
picks.blurb: Elm AV is Chris Blose, a Lancaster filmmaker married ten years, whose approach starts with the best possible coverage of the ceremony and reception and works outward from there. He wants couples to be able to see and hear it all later, and the site has an easy-booking page and published pricing.

picks.name: Solidity Films - Wedding Videographer
picks.blurb: Solidity Films makes personal wedding films focused on story and raw emotion, and says it would never make something just to get featured or gain followers. A Philadelphia team of filmmakers and editors with ten years of weddings behind it, which starts every film by asking for your story.

picks.name: Jordan Brian Studios
picks.blurb: Jordan Brian Studios shoots Philadelphia and South Jersey weddings as photographer and videographer, 21 years and 500-plus weddings in, and limits itself to 15 a year. The style is calm in the room and quietly everywhere when something real happens.

picks.name: Broadside Visuals, Lancaster PA Wedding Photographers and Wedding Videographers
picks.blurb: Broadside Visuals is a Lancaster photo and video team pitched at rebels in love, couples who live boldly. Based in Columbia and willing to go anywhere, with a style it describes as cinematic imagery and no staged fairytales.
